# Advanced Mermaid 0.2.2 checks

Reload the updated plugin, then open this note in Live Preview.

## Returning to Rendered View

The mode buttons should read **Rendered View**, **Live Editor**, **Static Editor**.

1. Select **Live Editor**, change a label, then select **Rendered View**. The
   latest diagram should appear. Repeat several times, including selecting
   Rendered View when it is already active.
2. Switch through **Static Editor** and back to **Rendered View**. The diagram
   should remain visible. There should be no Close Editor button.
3. Open a second pane with this note. Switching modes in one pane should leave
   the other pane's rendered diagram intact.
4. Add a paragraph before the fence, edit another label in Live Editor, and
   return to Rendered View. The latest labels should be retained.

```pele
%% advanced-mermaid-style:v1
%% .pele { --pele-border: #ff0000; --pele-surface: #153030; --pele-fg: #aaaaaa; }
%% advanced-mermaid-style:end
flowchart LR
  A[Source] --> B[Cached preview]
  B --> C[Rendered again]
  classDef default stroke-width:2px
```

This paragraph provides a cursor position outside the fence.

## Export alignment and Zoom settings

Open **Settings → Advanced Mermaid → Live editor settings → Editor style settings**.

- Check that the old Close button rows are absent.
- In the **Zoom** group, leave **Use global styles** off. Choose different light
  and dark border, font and background colors. They should color the Zoom rail
  and its icons in both Live Editor and rendered/Reading views, while the diagram
  keeps its authored red borders.
- Turn **Use global styles** on. The custom rows should hide and Zoom should use
  inherited colors. Turn it off to recover the saved custom colors.
- Check independent light/dark resets, alpha colors, invalid inputs, and settings
  persistence after reloading the plugin.
- Check that Export text is centered horizontally and vertically in Live Editor,
  including with a different button font size and a narrow pane.
- Confirm that zoom in/out/reset and pan still work. Press Esc in source to
  return to Rendered View using the keyboard.

```pele
flowchart LR
  Small --> Diagram
```
